repository.description: Path or URL to the Borg backup repository.

pruning.description: Whether to automatically prune old archives according to retention rules.

retention_keep_daily.description: Number of daily backups to retain.

retention_keep_weekly.description: Number of weekly backups to retain.

retention_keep_monthly.description: Number of monthly backups to retain.

retention_keep_yearly.description: Number of yearly backups to retain.

retention_prefix.description: Prefix used in archive names to group backups per host.

source_directories.description: List of directories to include in backups.

excludes.description: List of file/directory patterns to exclude from backups.

extra_borg_create_options.description: Additional command-line flags passed to `borg create`.

pre_backup.description: Shell commands to run before each backup (e.g., service freeze, fsync).

post_backup.description: Shell commands to run after each backup (e.g., service thaw, notifications).

on_error.description: Shell commands to run if backup fails (e.g., alerting scripts).

storage_archive_name_format.description: Format string for archive names (supports strftime and host variables).

storage_relimit.description: Optional read/write rate limits for backup speed control.

reads.description: Maximum read rate in bytes per second (e.g., 1048576 = 1 MiB/s).

writes.description: Maximum write rate in bytes per second.

monitoring_monitors.description: List of monitoring services to ping (e.g., Uptime Kuma, PagerDuty).

url.description: Uptime Kuma ping URL or custom webhook endpoint.

success_rate_threshold.description: Minimum success rate (0.0–1.0) required to consider backup healthy.

log_json.description: Whether to output logs in JSON format for structured logging.
